saferMake 1.0.0
  • Reference

    Shiny app launcher

    make.Rd

    Launch the shiny app that converts a user function into a safer-r function (see the safer-r project).

    make(safer_check = TRUE, lib_path = NULL, error_text = "")

    Arguments

    safer_check

    Single logical value. Perform some "safer" checks? If TRUE, checkings are performed before main code running (see the safer-r project): 1) correct lib_path argument value 2) required functions and related packages effectively present in local R libraries and 3) R classical operators (like "<-") not overwritten by another package because of the R scope. Requires the saferDev package. Must be set to FALSE if this function is used inside another "safer" function to avoid pointless multiple checkings.

    lib_path

    Vector of characters specifying the absolute pathways of the directories containing the required packages for the function, if not in the default directories. Useful when R packages are not installed in the default directories because of lack of admin rights. More precisely, lib_path is passed through the new argument of .libPaths() so that the new library paths are unique(c(new, .Library.site, .Library)). Warning: .libPaths() is restored to the initial paths, after function execution, i.e., when the app is closed. Ignored if NULL (default): only the pathways specified by the current .libPaths() are used for package calling.

    error_text

    Single character string used to add information in error messages returned by the function, notably if the function is inside other functions, which is practical for debugging. Example: error_text = " INSIDE <PACKAGE_1>::<FUNCTION_1> INSIDE <PACKAGE_2>::<FUNCTION_2>.". If NULL, converted into "".

    Value

    The value returned by shiny::runApp() when the app is closed, invisibly. The converted function is saved by the app in a .R file (download button of the app).

    Details

    The safer-r code verifications of the app (saferMake::test()) need the current version of the saferDev package (see https://github.com/safer-r/saferDev).

    Author

    Gael Millot

    Examples

    # Warning: these examples may not work well when using the "Run examples" link
# because of a particular environment. Please, copy-paste in a local environment.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
saferMake::make()
# all the arguments.
saferMake::make(safer_check = TRUE, lib_path = NULL, error_text = "")
} # }
